# Field Day

## What is Field Day?

::: {.incremental}
- a contest
- a social event
- a *field* operating exercise
- an open house for amateur radio
- a ton of fun in the rain & sun
:::

## NARC Field Day

- Saturday, June 28 - Sunday, June 29 (2:00 PM EDT - 2:00 PM EDT)
- **Pleasant Gap Fire Company training grounds**
  - Class 2 (transmitters) A^[If we do not operate independent of commercial power, we will be designated as A-Commercial.] (alpha), [club/non-club portable](http://www.arrl.org/field-day-rules)
  - Power: 100 W
  - W3YA callsign
- Food & drink

## Goal-setting 2025

::: {.incremental}
- Exceed 2024 QSO total (*n*=336)
  - {{< fa thumbs-up >}} Result: *n*=745
- Exceed 2024 attendee total (*n*=37) 
  - {{< fa thumbs-up >}} Result: *n*=41 
- Exceed 2024 operator total (*n*=13)
  - {{< fa thumbs-down >}} Result: *n*=12
- Have 75% attendees operate (2024 = 35%)
  - {{< fa thumbs-down >}} Result: `{r} round(100*12/41, 0)`%
  
::: 

## Goal-setting 2026

- Exceed 2025 operator total (*n* > 12)
- Support "playing radio" (rigs, antennas, modes)
  - Satellite
  - 2m simplex
  - 160m
  - Unconventional digital modes (SSTV, VarAC, JS8Call)
